synthesis.executive_summary: 今日5篇论文中，与OCR/文档解析直接相关的有3篇：Carry the Fine Print提出文档OCR视觉token两阶段压缩框架，在保留一半视觉token时达到未压缩模型95.42/96.09分，并显著降低延迟；When Figures Disagree with Text定义了在完整论文中自主定位图表-文本矛盾的验证任务，揭示“决定验证什么”是主要瓶颈；SEAF将OCR文本作为语义分支输入用于社交媒体多图像讽刺检测。另两篇（扩散Transformer RL后训练、个性化Agent记忆）与OCR/文档解析仅有间接关联，前者涉及文本渲染（OCR）质量，后者与文档解析任务无关。
synthesis.trend_summary: 文档OCR研究正从“提升识别精度”转向“在固定视觉token预算下保持转录保真度”，压缩策略强调选择与补偿解耦而非单纯剪枝。同时，视觉证据验证从给定图表的一致性判断，转向在完整文档中自主决定验证对象，检索与验证的耦合成为新瓶颈。OCR文本的角色也在扩展：从纯转录输出变为下游多模态推理（如讽刺检测）的语义补充信号。
common_innovations: 将视觉信息筛选与信息补偿/融合分离为两个阶段或分支，避免单一压缩或加权策略的信息损失

engineering_takeaways: Carry the Fine Print的两阶段压缩可直接用于大规模文档数字化：50% token预算下批量完成时间快35-40%，且输出长度失控显著减少（3个 vs 30-34个）。

papers.title: SEAF: Selective Semantic Enrichment and Visual Evidence Fusion for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection
papers.summary: Multimodal sarcasm detection requires textual, visual, and contextual evidence, particularly when multiple images provide complementary cues. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate auxiliary information from a post's text and images, but their outputs may mix useful background knowledge with redundant visual descriptions. We propose SEAF, a dual-branch framework for selective semantic enrichment and visual evidence fusion. SEAF assigns generated fields to distinct roles: entity background enriches semantic input, while image descriptions supply alignment statistics. The semantic branch combines the original post text, background from a frozen MLLM, and optical character recognition (OCR) text. The aligned visual branch combines global and local visual features with statistics of cross-modal and inter-image similarity. Text-Anchored Smoothed Aggregation (TASA) weights images by their similarity to the original post text while preserving contributions from images with low literal similarity. Summing the branch classification scores integrates contextual semantics with visual evidence. Experiments on the multi-image MMSD3.0 benchmark show that SEAF outperforms all compared methods.
papers.zh_summary: 该论文提出SEAF，一个用于多模态讽刺检测的双分支框架。SEAF利用冻结的多模态大语言模型生成实体背景知识和图像描述，并将OCR文本与原始帖子文本结合作为语义分支输入；视觉分支则融合全局和局部视觉特征以及跨模态和图像间相似度统计。通过文本锚定的平滑聚合（TASA）方法，根据图像与原始文本的相似度对图像进行加权，同时保留低字面相似度图像的贡献。最终通过求和两个分支的分类分数来整合上下文语义和视觉证据。在MMSD3.0多图像基准测试上，SEAF优于所有对比方法。
papers.novelty: 提出选择性语义丰富和视觉证据融合的双分支框架，利用MLLM生成的信息的不同角色（实体背景用于语义增强，图像描述提供对齐统计），并设计TASA机制动态加权多图像贡献。
innovation_points: 双分支架构分别处理语义增强和视觉证据对齐，并融合分类分数

papers.title: When Figures Disagree with Text: Evaluating Autonomous Visual Evidence Verification in Scientific Papers
papers.summary: Scientific figures carry evidence for the claims that cite them, so reviewing a paper means checking that a figure agrees with the text, and not only describing what the figure shows. Benchmarks of figure-text verification typically hand the model the figure, the claim, or the knowledge that an inconsistency exists, which leaves untested whether a model can find the figure worth checking in a complete paper, relate a visual element to the claim it conflicts with, and recognize the conflict. We study this autonomous setting on 31 full manuscripts, each carrying a reviewer-documented figure-text inconsistency from PRISMM-Bench that is hidden from the model. Six multimodal models review each PDF under a neutral prompt, and we then add one input at a time to the same manuscripts. Of 1,445 open-ended reviews, 60.6% mention the flawed figure, yet a grading rubric accepts only 3.3% as diagnosing its contradiction; a blind audit finds the rubric lenient, so we read these as rubric-accepted rates and compare conditions rather than absolute values. In a separate controlled run, naming the figure, without stating that it is flawed, raises rubric-accepted diagnosis from 4.3% to 20.4%, while a consistency instruction and coarse visual cues do not. When the contradiction is visible only in the rendered figure, text-only review yields no accepted diagnosis, while review of the rendered pages with the figure named reaches 15.8%. A baseline that lets the model choose which figures to check, ranked by centrality, stays at 4.8%. Deciding what to verify is thus a large part of the difficulty, and the selection rule we tested does not resolve it. Multimodal document understanding should be evaluated on whether a model can propose what to verify, not only answer questions about a figure it is handed.
papers.zh_summary: 该论文研究自主视觉证据验证任务：在完整科学论文中，模型需自主找到与文本主张矛盾的图表并识别矛盾。基于31篇完整手稿（每篇包含PRISMM-Bench中记录的图表-文本不一致），测试了六个多模态模型在 neutral prompt 下的表现。结果显示，60.6%的开放式评审提及了有缺陷的图表，但仅3.3%被评分标准接受为诊断出矛盾。在控制实验中，仅指明图表（不告知有缺陷）可将接受率从4.3%提升至20.4%，而一致性指令和粗粒度视觉线索无效。当矛盾仅存在于渲染图表中时，纯文本评审无法诊断，而命名图表的渲染页面评审达到15.8%。基于中心性排序的图表选择基线仅4.8%。表明“决定验证什么”是困难的重要部分。

papers.title: Carry the Fine Print: Budget-Aware Visual Token Compression for Document OCR
papers.summary: Visual token compression often treats salience or similarity as a proxy for transcription importance. Complete document OCR breaks this assumption: small symbols and repeated entries can be indispensable to the transcript despite being visually inconspicuous. We present Select and Compensate, a two-stage framework built on a simple idea: choosing where to retain a token need not determine all the evidence it carries. Selection combines adaptive encoding resolution with global importance and local contrast to choose which tokens to retain as anchors. Compensation enriches these anchors with nearby discarded content and its relative position, without adding tokens. The OCR backbone remains frozen, and native coordinates and structural tokens are preserved. We evaluate complete page transcription across five backbones on OmniDocBench and document reconstruction on MPDocBench. With half the original visual tokens, our input-adapted configuration reaches 95.42 OmniDocBench Overall on Ovis versus 96.09 for the uncompressed model, and paired evaluations show gains over simply reducing the input resolution on both benchmarks. With the original input grid, our method stays within 0.17 points of the uncompressed model at 75% retention and exceeds a learned global selector by 4.70 points at 25%. On a fixed 200-page Ovis workload at the same 50% visual-token budget, only 3 of its outputs hit the length limit, versus 30-34 for the evaluated RTPrune, DivPrune, and HiPrune adaptations, and it finishes the batch 35-40% sooner. Code will be made publicly available.
papers.zh_summary: 该论文提出Select and Compensate两阶段框架，用于文档OCR中的视觉token压缩。选择阶段结合自适应编码分辨率、全局重要性和局部对比度选择保留的锚点token；补偿阶段用附近被丢弃的内容及其相对位置丰富锚点，而不增加token数量。OCR骨干网络保持冻结，保留原生坐标和结构token。在OmniDocBench和MPDocBench上评估，使用一半视觉token时，输入自适应配置达到95.42分（Ovis），未压缩模型为96.09；在原始输入网格下，75%保留率时与未压缩模型差距在0.17分内，25%保留率时超过学习式全局选择器4.70分。在固定200页Ovis工作负载下，50% token预算时仅3个输出达到长度限制（对比方法为30-34个），批量完成时间快35-40%。
papers.novelty: 针对文档OCR中视觉token压缩的“显著性≠转录重要性”问题，提出选择与补偿分离的两阶段框架，在不增加token的情况下通过邻域补偿保留关键细节。
innovation_points: 提出两阶段框架：选择锚点token与补偿邻域信息解耦，避免因压缩丢失小符号或重复条目

papers.limitations: 未在更多样化的文档类型（如手写、复杂表格）上验证；补偿机制可能引入额外计算开销；依赖预定义的分辨率自适应策略，可能需针对不同文档调整。

将方法扩展到多页文档和流式OCR场景
研究动态token预算分配，根据文档内容复杂度自适应调整保留率
结合布局分析信息优化锚点选择，提升表格和公式的转录准确性

papers.engineering_value: 为文档OCR系统提供高效的视觉token压缩方案，显著降低计算和延迟，适用于大规模文档数字化和实时OCR应用，具有直接部署价值。
papers.why_relevant: 论文直接针对文档OCR的视觉token压缩，涉及保留小符号和结构信息，与OCR文档解析中的效率与精度平衡问题高度相关。

papers.title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers. Because capabilities such as rendering requested text or composing multiple objects are inherently prompt-dependent, a natural hypothesis is that improving them requires learning complex, input-dependent transformations. To isolate how much of these gains an input-independent shift explains, we probe each RL-tuned model with a deliberately simple parameterization: a fixed set of steering vectors added to the block outputs of the frozen base model. On SD3.5-M, these vectors hold 65x fewer parameters than the RL-tuned LoRA (0.29M against 18.8M). We fit them to match the velocity predictions of public RL-tuned checkpoints, with no reward in the objective. Although the vectors are identical for every prompt, token, and sampling seed, they recover 90.0-96.3% of the reward gains of six RL-tuned image models, and 89.8% and 111.9% on two RL-tuned video models. Initialized at zero and trained with online RL, the vectors alone exceed the reward gains of weight-based RL on text rendering (OCR) and human preference (PickScore) on SD3.5-M. A constant shift thus suffices for most of the gain of policy-gradient RL post-training: without new input-dependent transformations, it steers the pretrained generator toward what it can already compute.
papers.zh_summary: 该论文探究扩散Transformer中强化学习后训练的增益来源。通过用一组固定的、与输入无关的steering向量（添加到冻结基础模型的块输出）来匹配公开RL调优检查点的速度预测，发现这些向量参数量比RL调优的LoRA少65倍（0.29M vs 18.8M），却能恢复六个图像模型90.0-96.3%的奖励增益，两个视频模型上为89.8%和111.9%。在SD3.5-M上，零初始化并经在线RL训练的向量在文本渲染（OCR）和人类偏好（PickScore）上超过基于权重的RL。表明恒定偏移足以解释大部分策略梯度RL后训练的增益，无需学习复杂的输入依赖变换。
papers.novelty: 揭示扩散Transformer的RL后训练增益主要可通过输入无关的恒定激活偏移（steering向量）复现，挑战了需要学习复杂输入依赖变换的假设。
innovation_points: 用固定steering向量参数化RL后训练效果，参数量极少却恢复大部分奖励增益
证明恒定偏移在文本渲染（OCR）和人类偏好任务上可超越基于权重的RL
提出零初始化在线RL训练steering向量的方法，无需奖励目标即可拟合
在图像和视频扩散模型上验证了结论的普适性
papers.limitations: 仅测试了公开RL调优检查点和少数模型，未涵盖所有RL算法；steering向量与输入无关，可能无法处理需要细粒度输入条件的任务；未分析向量在不同提示下的语义含义。
improvement_directions: 探索条件化steering向量（轻量输入依赖）以处理更复杂的组合任务
将方法扩展到更多扩散架构和RL算法（如DPO）
分析steering向量在OCR文本渲染中的具体作用机制，提升文字生成质量
研究steering向量与LoRA等微调方法的结合，平衡效率与表达能力
在视频生成中进一步验证恒定偏移的局限性，特别是时序一致性任务
papers.engineering_value: 为扩散模型的高效后训练提供新思路，可用极少参数实现RL调优的大部分效果，降低计算成本，尤其有利于文本渲染（OCR）和偏好对齐的快速适配。
papers.why_relevant: 论文涉及扩散模型在文本渲染（OCR）上的改进，并发现恒定steering向量即可提升OCR质量，对OCR生成和文档图像合成有潜在影响。

papers.title: STARK: Moving towards Personalized Agents That Truly Learn and Remember
papers.summary: Long-term memory is essential for personalized agentic systems that interact with users over long time periods, yet current architectures only capture what happened while leaving the reasoning of why it happened to be derived later by underlying LLMs.%, and silo knowledge within individual users. These events can, however, convey not only what a user experienced but also how that experience shaped their behavioral patterns. We introduce STARK, a dual-graph memory architecture which treats these events not just as nodes but also as edges between behavioral insights. STARK maintains an Episodic Graph which records interactions as temporally, causally, and semantically linked episodes; and an Insight Graph which represents LLM-extracted behavioral signals scored by how many events support them, connected by the very events that led to them. At inference, behavioral knowledge is retrieved directly from insight nodes grounded by event-as-edges, eliminating repeated episodic traversal. The event-as-edge structure also naturally enables projecting the knowledge graph into a relational embedding space where cross-user transfer becomes possible under shared contextual circumstances, allowing the system to infer missing insights for cold-start users. Evaluations show that STARK improves by 1.48 judge score on LongMemEval information extraction and 0.93 on LoCoMo open domain questions over state of the art. On the public LongLaMP abstract-generation benchmark, cross-user transfer improves open-ended judge scores by 0.7 points and ROUGE-L by 3 at 5% graph sparsity.
papers.zh_summary: 该论文提出STARK，一种用于个性化智能体的双图记忆架构。STARK将交互事件视为行为洞察之间的边，维护一个情景图（记录时间、因果和语义链接的交互）和一个洞察图（LLM提取的行为信号，按支持事件数评分，并由导致它们的事件连接）。推理时直接从洞察节点检索行为知识，以事件为边进行 grounding，避免重复遍历情景图。事件为边的结构还支持将知识图谱投影到关系嵌入空间，实现跨用户迁移，为冷启动用户推断缺失洞察。在LongMemEval信息提取上提升1.48个judge分数，LoCoMo开放域问题上提升0.93；在LongLaMP摘要生成基准上，5%图稀疏度时跨用户迁移提升开放域judge分数0.7和ROUGE-L 3分。
papers.novelty: 提出事件作为边的双图记忆架构，将交互事件同时作为行为洞察之间的连接，支持直接检索行为知识并实现跨用户迁移。
innovation_points: 双图架构：情景图记录交互，洞察图存储行为信号并由事件边连接
事件作为边的设计，使行为知识检索无需遍历情景图，提升效率
通过关系嵌入空间实现跨用户知识迁移，解决冷启动问题
在多个长期记忆基准上验证了信息提取和开放域问答的改进
papers.limitations: 依赖LLM提取行为信号的质量；跨用户迁移可能引发隐私问题；仅在有限基准上评估，未在真实长期交互中验证；图稀疏度对性能的影响需进一步研究。
improvement_directions: 研究更鲁棒的行为信号提取方法，减少LLM幻觉
设计隐私保护机制，支持跨用户迁移时的匿名化
在真实个性化助手场景中进行长期部署评估
探索动态图更新策略，适应行为模式变化
结合多模态交互数据（如语音、图像）丰富记忆内容
papers.engineering_value: 为个性化智能体提供可扩展的长期记忆架构，支持高效行为知识检索和跨用户冷启动，可应用于对话系统、推荐系统等需要长期用户建模的场景。
papers.why_relevant: 论文涉及长期记忆架构，其中可能包含多模态交互数据，但未直接涉及OCR或文档解析；与OCR领域关联较弱，但记忆机制对文档理解中的长期上下文建模有间接参考价值。
